items.title: EPSS Surge: CVE-2018-11714
items.analysis: EPSS exploitation probability for CVE-2018-11714 surged from 35% to 68% (percentile 99%), indicating a significant increase in predicted or observed exploitation activity for this 2018-era vulnerability. It is not (yet) in CISA KEV — this signal typically precedes KEV listing and press coverage. An issue was discovered on TP-Link TL-WR840N v5 00000005 0.9.1 3.16 v0001.0 Build 170608 Rel.58696n and TL-WR841N v13 00000013 0.9.1 4.16 v0001.0 Build 170622 Rel.64334n devices. This issue is caused by improper session handling on the /cgi/ folder or a /cgi file. If an attacker sends a header of "Referer: http://192.168.0.1/mainFrame.htm" then no authentication is required for any action.

items.title: EPSS Surge: CVE-2019-1003030
items.analysis: EPSS exploitation probability for CVE-2019-1003030 surged from 76% to 97% (percentile 100%), indicating a significant increase in predicted or observed exploitation activity for this 2019-era vulnerability. It is not (yet) in CISA KEV — this signal typically precedes KEV listing and press coverage. A sandbox bypass vulnerability exists in Jenkins Pipeline: Groovy Plugin 2.63 and earlier in pom.xml, src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/workflow/cps/CpsGroovyShell.java that allows attackers able to control pipeline scripts to execute arbitrary code on the Jenkins master JVM.
